title: Fireworks AI Targets $30B to $40B Valuation Months After $17.5B Round
summary:
A venture founded by former employees of Google and Meta is pursuing new investment to expand its operations. Fireworks AI is seeking a valuation between $30 billion and $40 billion in a new funding round, an increase from the $17.5 billion valuation it reached only a few months ago, according to Business Insider.

Some observers argue that current AI valuations are disconnected from business realities, noting that annualized revenue provides limited insight into company performance. Questions have also been raised regarding whether the growth of such firms is driven by clients that are themselves funded by venture capital.
